scope: Owner-requested standalone saved-detection annotated tracking video; no domain histories or Phase 2 closure
command: UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=.cache/phase2-tracking-cpu uv run --locked --offline --extra tracking --extra video collision-warning track-preview --source data/external/kitti-0005-acceptance.mkv --detection-run outputs/phase1-clean-gpu-acceptance/gpu-1 --output outputs/phase2-tracking-preview

checks.make_check: passed: Ruff lint/format, strict mypy (11 files), 45 default tests
checks.base_wheel: Built sdist/wheel; installed wheel without dependencies in new venv; isolated import and track-preview help pass; no mandatory runtime dependencies or media/caches in distributions
checks.hosted_ci: not run; required CPU workflow includes generated tracking preview tests with tracking and video extras

findings: Confirmed per-class IDs and confidence labels are visible on cyclists, people and vehicles.
Unassigned observations remain gray; overlapping boxes/labels can crowd the scene.
Confirmed annotations draw after unassigned annotations.

replay.attribution: Andreas Geiger, Philip Lenz, Christoph Stiller, Raquel Urtasun; Vision meets Robotics: The KITTI Dataset (2013)

limitations: Association preview only; IDs are unverified identity hypotheses.
Per-class association can fragment IDs when the detector changes class.
Only original observed boxes are drawn; no predicted boxes or histories.
No TTC, distance or collision-risk evaluation; source audio is omitted.
Playback starts at zero; source intervals are retained to microseconds.
Odd dimensions are padded at right/bottom; coordinates are unchanged.
Input is the processed video prefix recorded by the detection run.
Detections removed during inference cannot be recovered by tracking.
No domain histories, continuity segments, IDF1/HOTA or end-to-end performance acceptance.
One short KITTI development sequence; no unique-object or generalization claim.
Historical milestone-1 evidence records file hashes before this preview extension.
